# Introduction

Welcome to the textbook section for Urban Farm Applied Mathematics.

![](../resources/farm-photos/farm_barn.jpg){width=70%}

This textbook combines farm science and practical maths so students can learn with real places, real tasks, and real data.

# Chapter 1: Introduction to Farming

## Overview

This chapter introduces core farming ideas, agriculture systems, and practical farm contexts.

![](../resources/farm-photos/farm_shed.jpg){width=65%}

## Key Concepts

- Types of Farming
- Sustainable Practices
- Technology in Farming

### Student Image Prompt

Use the image below to discuss: What jobs happen in this space each day, and what measurements would help plan those jobs?

![](../resources/farm-photos/chickens_water_food.jpg){width=65%}

# Chapter 2: Daily Challenges in Farming

## Overview

This chapter covers weather, market factors, and pest management in day-to-day farm decision-making.

![](../resources/farm-photos/sheep_water.jpg){width=65%}

## Key Concepts

- Weather Impact
- Economic Factors
- Pest Control Strategies

### Student Image Prompt

Look at the chicken area image and list three risks and three improvements. Then rank them from most urgent to least urgent.

![](../resources/farm-photos/chicken_door.jpg){width=65%}

# Interactive Components

This section will include interactive elements that allow students to engage with the material actively. These components will be developed in the `interactive` folder and linked here.

# Conclusion

This textbook provides a foundational overview and supports the practical farm units in this site.
